description: A legacy index directly after an attribute-only splat selects from each element
notes: The spec's grammar lets an attribute-only splat consume only attribute accesses (attrSplat = "." "*" GetAttr*) and says a legacy index is an index operation, not an attribute access, so .0 would select the first element of the splat's result, [1, 2]. hashicorp/hcl deliberately includes legacy indexes in an attribute-only splat (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go).
